_schema.note: Every number a motion graphics video states on screen must have a record here. Nothing goes on screen unless it exists in this file with status 'confirmed'. Shared across every series in motion/.

fields.value: machine-readable value. Rates as decimals (0.0169), money in pounds, pence in pence.
fields.display: exactly how it is rendered on screen.
fields.on_screen_label: the label rendered beside it. NEVER a provider name — see rail 2.
fields.internal_source: traceability only. May name a provider. NEVER rendered.
fields.verified_on: ISO date. Older than 90 days fails the build with a warning.
fields.status: confirmed | draft | blocked. A blocked record fails the build if an episode references it. A draft record (16 Sep 2026) is one Faisal has released for a DRAFT build only: verify.py accepts it through draft_figure(), marks the build DRAFT, and every export carries -DRAFT until confirm_open is settled and the status is confirmed.
fields.confirm_open: draft records only: what is still open with Eray before the figure can be confirmed.
fields.footer: the source line this figure contributes to the persistent footer.

_schema.verified_on_policy: warn at 90 days, from the date the figure was last checked against its source, not the date this file was edited.

Every OTHER rate stays blocked: /CLAUDE.md still says do not state the terminal price or any transaction rate, the internal figures still conflict (1.30%+15p standard, 0.80% bespoke floor, 0.70% flat in the video series) and it is still an open question for Eray. Do not state a rate that isn't the workhorse tier without asking.

fixed_fee_8p.blocked_reason: The 8p FEE is confirmed as part of neropay_workhorse_rate. What stays blocked is the AGREEMENT question: does 8p alone trigger the 18-month agreement? Until Eray answers, nothing may claim 'no contract' at 8p, and episode 5 (8p vs 15p) stays unwritten.

flex_price.blocked_reason: NeroPay Flex has no confirmed price. CLAUDE.md unconfirmed list; brief rail 6.

partner_incentive.blocked_reason: Retired record. The partner programme's public figures were confirmed final by Faisal on 17 Sep 2026 (motion/partner/BRIEF.md v4) and live as partner_bonus_tiers, partner_revenue_share_tiers and partner_active_gate. This key stays blocked so nothing references it by the old name: any negotiated partner terms beyond the public tiers are still rail 10.

partner_bonus_tiers.on_screen_label: per merchant, by their total card processing in their first 30 days
partner_bonus_tiers.note: Bonus per verified active merchant: £100 at £0–£20,000 of first-30-day processing, £200 at £20,000.01–£39,999.99, £300 at £40,000 and above. Always on screen with the volume that earns it (the Bonus Dial). Per unit, never a total. 'up to £300' only on the dial's rest frame, with '£40,000+ in their first 30 days' in the same line.
partner_bonus_tiers.internal_source: motion/partner/BRIEF.md v4 final, Part 1 (Faisal, 17 Sep 2026: all figures confirmed final, no open questions; £500 in older material is superseded)
partner_bonus_tiers.footer: Bonus paid per verified active merchant, £100–£300 based on their total processing volume in their first 30 days. Terms: partners.neropay.app

partner_revenue_share_tiers.on_screen_label: share of what your merchants' card payments earn NeroPay, by new active merchants introduced in the calendar month
partner_revenue_share_tiers.note: The rate is set by the count of NEW active merchants introduced in the calendar month and paid on the whole network. Never a pound figure, never a share of merchant turnover. The rest frame carries '111+ new active merchants in one month' and 'Most partners start at 20%: three a month'.
partner_revenue_share_tiers.internal_source: motion/partner/BRIEF.md v4 final, Part 1 (Faisal, 17 Sep 2026: a share of what the merchants' card payments earn NeroPay, never turnover, never a pound figure; videos say no more than 'paid to your partner account')
partner_revenue_share_tiers.footer: Revenue share requires a minimum of three new active merchants in the same calendar month; the rate depends on how many are introduced that month. Terms: partners.neropay.app

partner_active_gate.on_screen_label: new active merchants in a calendar month to be an Active Partner
partner_active_gate.note: A gate, not a cap. Under three in a month: no revenue share that month; every bonus is still paid.
partner_active_gate.internal_source: motion/partner/BRIEF.md v4 final, Part 1 (Faisal, 17 Sep 2026: an active merchant is enabled and has taken at least one successful payment; videos say 'active' or 'live and taking payments')
partner_active_gate.footer: Revenue share needs 3+ new active merchants per calendar month.

neropay_workhorse_rate.internal_source: NEROPAY_CONTEXT §3 quoting ladder, supplied by Faisal in EP01-RUN-PROMPT 14 Sep 2026
neropay_workhorse_rate.caveat: Two things to settle before anything using this publishes. (1) /CLAUDE.md records the internal standard as 1.30% + 15p, not + 8p. At 15p a £4 coffee is 5.05%, not 3.30%, so every figure in episode 1 depends on 8p being the right tier. (2) 'no contract' contradicts the open question with Eray about whether 8p alone triggers the 18-month agreement — see fixed_fee_8p. If it does, the footer claim is false.

psr_terminal_lease_cap.on_screen_label: the maximum minimum term for a card terminal lease or rental

psr_terminal_lease_cap.footer: Terminal lease cap: 18 months, then 31-day rolling. PSR PS22/2, Oct 2022; directed providers only.
psr_terminal_lease_cap.note: After the minimum term, rolling renewal of no more than 31 days; exit fees must be cost-based and explained up front.

psr_trigger_messages.note: Timing linked to the minimum-term expiry; for indefinite contracts at least every 30 days. Applies to the 14 largest acquirers, not every ISO or reseller.
